flashcard_questions.a: A coastline where rock layers run parallel to the shore.
A coastline where bands of hard and soft rock meet the shore at right angles.

flashcard_questions.q: Why does a bay form on a discordant coastline?
flashcard_questions.a: The softer rock is eroded faster than the harder rock on either side of it.

flashcard_questions.q: Which soft rock was eroded away to form Swanage Bay?
Which landform develops when a cave is eroded right through a headland?
Which landform is left standing when the roof of an arch collapses?
What is cut into the base of a cliff between the high and low tide marks?
A wave-cut platform slopes gently towards the sea at about ____°.
Which Dorset landmark shows stacks and stumps at different stages of erosion?
What is a spit in coastal geography?
flashcard_questions.a: A ridge of sand or shingle joined to the mainland at one end, extending seawards.

flashcard_questions.q: Why can a spit not grow right across a river estuary?
flashcard_questions.a: The river current carries sediment out to sea, stopping the spit reaching the far bank.

flashcard_questions.q: What is a bar in coastal geography?
flashcard_questions.a: A ridge of sand or shingle stretching across a bay and joining two headlands.

flashcard_questions.q: What is a tombolo at the coast?
flashcard_questions.a: A bar of sand or shingle that connects an island to the mainland.

flashcard_questions.q: Which plant binds sand grains together and stabilises coastal dunes?
Which Dorset cove formed where waves broke through hard limestone into softer clay?

notes: 15 cards: 5 term-to-definition (concordant, discordant, spit, bar, tombolo), 4 process-to-landform (bay, arch, stack, wave-cut notch), 1 cloze on the platform gradient figure, 2 cause-to-consequence (bay erosion rate, spit and estuary current), 3 case-study-to-fact naming the place (Swanage clay, Old Harry Rocks, Lulworth Cove). Stump, beach and embryo-dune definitions plus Chesil Beach and the 250-million-year Jurassic Coast age were trimmed to stay within 15; bar and tombolo kept because their answers stay clearly distinguishable.
